chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyād, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from ʿĀṣim ibn Ḥumayd, from one who informed him, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام would not cut off the thief's hand during days of famine.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, a title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.أَيَّامِ الْمَجَاعَةِ: days of famine and widespread hunger
key_terms.لَا يَقْطَعُ: he would not carry out amputation

ai.seo_question: Was the hadd punishment for theft applied during famine in the practice of Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام did not enforce the hadd punishment for theft during times of famine. It indicates a legal consideration of public hardship and necessity in the application of penal rulings.
